RellW_MountUp.name: Ferromancy: Mount Up
RellW_MountUp.tooltip:
Passive - Dismounted Resilience: Rell gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:ResistanceIncrease*100@% increased Armor and Magic Resist, @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedASBoost*100@% Attack Speed and @spell.RellW_Dismount:DismountedRangeBoost@ Attack Range while dismounted.

Active - Ferromancy: Mount Up: Rell mounts up and briefly gains @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeed*100@% Decaying Move Speed. Her next Attack within @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountUpSpeedDuration@ seconds Knocks Up and throws enemies behind her, dealing an additional @spell.RellW_Dismount:FlipDamage@ magic damage.

Rell then enters her mounted form, gaining @spell.RellW_Dismount:MountedMoveSpeed@ Move Speed. While mounted, Rell can use Ferromancy: Crash Down.
